description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointID functionality within the OpenClaw project, specifically testing decoding and normalization of service names and descriptions using Network framework endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointIDTests
classes.description: A test suite for GatewayEndpointID functionalities, including decoding and normalization of service names with special character escapes.

methods.name: stableIDForServiceDecodesAndNormalizesName
methods.description: Tests that a service endpoint decodes and normalizes names correctly, accounting for Bonjour escape sequences.

methods.name: stableIDForNonServiceUsesEndpointDescription
methods.description: Tests that non-service endpoints generate the stable ID using their endpoint description.

methods.name: prettyDescriptionDecodesBonjourEscapes
methods.description: Tests that the pretty description correctly decodes Bonjour escape sequences and matches expected descriptions.
